provenance.question: Does wrapAndUnwrapSol:false still land on native lamports, or does it require an existing wrapped-SOL token account?
provenance.note: Read-only. Two sequential calls differing ONLY in wrapAndUnwrapSol. Nothing was signed or broadcast. Instructions are summarized by program id and decoded discriminant; no signable bytes are retained.
provenance.conclusion: Wrapping on funds the swap from native lamports (System Transfer of exactly inAmount, then SyncNative, with a CloseAccount cleanup). Wrapping off carries none of those instructions and spends an existing wrapped-SOL token account. There is therefore no provider-supported native landing for tokenIn SOL with wrapAndUnwrapSol disabled.
